title: gf2-algebra README plus doc-test examples
description:
Write the `gf2-algebra` README with usage examples, and add doc-test examples to all public APIs (per the project's documentation standards in CLAUDE.md).

## Background

CLAUDE.md §Documentation standards: every public item needs a doc comment with description, `# Arguments`, `# Examples` (tested), `# Panics`, and `# Complexity` (for non-trivial operations). The doc-test examples are exercised by `cargo test --doc`; they must compile and pass.

This issue covers both the crate-level `README.md` and the per-item doc comments for the public surface (`PackedField`, `Bipedal3`, `permanent_ryser`, `permanent_bipedal3`, `permanent_bipedal5`, `permanent_bipedal7`, `gpu::*`).

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `crates/gf2-algebra/README.md` exists with: motivation, basic usage example, perf headline numbers (post-S1), feature flags table, and link to the epic design doc.
- [ ] [hard] Every public item in `gf2-algebra::packed::*`, `gf2-algebra::permanent::*`, and `gf2-algebra::gpu::*` (when `hip` feature on) has a doc-comment per CLAUDE.md standards.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo test --doc -p gf2-algebra --all-features` passes (every `# Examples` block compiles and runs).
- [ ] [hard] At least one runnable example under `crates/gf2-algebra/examples/permanent_demo.rs` reproduces the headline benchmark within $\pm 5\%$ (epic success criterion 12).
- [ ] [hard] `cargo run -p gf2-algebra --example permanent_demo --release` succeeds.
